page.title: Weight follows recency
page.body:
## Recency should be felt, not decoded

Fresh pages carry full weight. Older pages fade only as far as readability allows, because memory should age without becoming unavailable.

The row also carries a small weight bar: **dense**, *middle*, and thin. That louder cue does the semantic work while the title stays readable.

- The curve is logarithmic after the first day.
- The floor keeps contrast above AA in both palettes.
- The browser uses `color-mix` so the same rule follows light and dark paper.

```js
inkStepFor(updated_at, new Date())
```

Related notes are repaired into the page with [quiet seams](./linked-memory).

timeline.text: Recency curve fixed to a narrow contrast-safe range.
Ink bar separated the semantic cue from title darkness.
Dark palette checked against the same ground tokens.
Rows switched from boxes to hanging text.
The reader pane replaced centered dialogs.
